title: Enquirer’s Guide: Can people send messages through the Stratum?
summary: They can send short coded messages by echo relay.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “Can people send messages through the Stratum?”
They can send short coded messages by echo relay.

An operator presses a key to alter a tuned Referent; a distant listening cabinet records the arriving pulses without needing a local aperture. Similar forms may produce false repetitions or fragments at several receivers, so offices preserve the original trace.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
